blocks.content:
• Igneous rocks are primary rocks.
• Basalt forms ocean floors.
• Sedimentary rocks contain fossils.
• Marble forms from limestone.
• Rock cycle is continuous.

items: Frequently asked: Sedimentary rocks are the only rock type containing fossils.
High yield point: Basalt forms the primary layer of ocean floors.
Metamorphism focus: Marble forms specifically from limestone transformation.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Igneous rocks serve as the primary rocks from which others originate.
Basalt is the principal rock composition forming ocean floors.
Sedimentary rocks uniquely contain trapped organic fossils.
Marble is a metamorphic rock produced from limestone.
The rock cycle is an ongoing, continuous geological process.
